notes: Modified cash basis village; governmental = General, Street, Fire and Ambulance and Other Governmental funds (Total Governmental Funds column, pp5-6); business-type = Water and Sewer (p8 Total column, modified cash basis; equals p2 business-type expenditures 120,605 and charges 171,701). Roll-forward on fund balance: 462,660 + 599,678 - 638,308 + 95,478 - 95,478 = 424,030; transfers are fund-column sums (Total column blank). Business-type net position: 502,597 + 171,753 - 120,605 = 553,745. Ending cash = cash and cash equivalents + cash at county treasurer (p4), certificates of deposit 42,431 as investments; no beginning cash printed. County treasurer revenues 226,004 split using the Statement of Activities general revenues (p3: property taxes 177,278, motor vehicle taxes 14,540, both equal to the p11 county treasurer schedule); remainder 34,186 is inside p3 Intergovernmental sources (34,185 by subtraction, rounding 1). Balance sheet: governmental lines from the governmental funds statement (p4, totals equal p1 424,030); business-type from p1. Detail: the budget schedule (p9) is a combined all-funds schedule, so per-fund statement columns are used for General, Street, Fire and Ambulance (pp5-6), Water and Sewer (p8); nonmajor funds use their combining schedule (p10) per fund column (9 funds). p5 Other Governmental Funds shows Donations 230 and Other revenues 5,808, while p10 prints Other revenues 6,038 combined; p5 shows Police 26,000 as Public Safety and Trash 56,686 as Trash, which p10 prints on the General government row. County Treasurer schedule (p11) not recorded in detail: the same money is in the County treasurer revenues lines. Read pages 1-11 of 11
